title: Commit-manifest byte-domain discriminator
failure_signature: A source-manifest probe compared checkout byte counts to raw Git blob sizes and reported false mismatches despite exact path parity.
trigger_preconditions: A commit-local manifest declares checkout_bytes_domain separately from git_blob identity.
Later commits may have changed files that were present in an earlier staged manifest.
candidate_workaround: Validate changed-path parity and Git object identity at the named commit, then use the retained staged-review receipt for checkout-domain byte parity instead of equating checkout bytes with raw blob size.
recurrence_guard: Read hash_domain and checkout_bytes_domain before comparing sizes; never infer that the two byte domains are identical.
rollback: Discard the false mismatch conclusion and retain the failed probe as an operational negative.
scope_boundary: Source commit manifests and their retained staged-review receipts only; no source mutation and no independent-reproduction credit.
